description: The three-card grid on the Sisters hub. Contains bozzies/sister-card children; renders Astro's exact <ul class="sisters-cards"> DOM.

attributes.name: Martha Boswell
attributes.quote: If we sang according to orthodox musical traditions, Vet would be the high voice or soprano, I would be the middle or alto, and Connie would be the low or contralto.

attributes.name: Connee Boswell
attributes.quote: We had loads of fun with our swinging trio. We were billed one time as musicians and in small print it said, "They also sing".

attributes.name: Vet Boswell
attributes.quote: A tribute to Charles M. Boswell, our father, who taught us three girls to love and respect music.
